# finix-ui

> Plain HTML/CSS/JS admin component framework distilled from the best free shadcn-ecosystem patterns (shadcn/ui, ReUI, Kibo UI, Tremor, assistant-ui, Shadcn Studio, Animate UI, and more). Pixel-faithful to the shadcn v4 visual language via a verbatim OKLCH token port; behavior rebuilt on native platform features (<dialog>, Popover API, <details name>) — no React, no build step. Works in any server-rendered stack (Rails, Django, Laravel, Go, PHP, JSP) or static HTML.

## Quick start

Include in <head>:
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/tokens.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/finix.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/finix-widgets.css">   (only for app-shell/stat/kanban/chat widgets)
  <script defer src="js/finix.js"></script>

Theming: set attributes on <html>:
  data-theme="light" | "dark"
  data-brand="finix" | "mono" | "ocean" | "forest" | "sunset"
Identity (v0.5): the DEFAULT finix look is "warm sage" — warm bone-tinted neutrals (never pure white/gray), sage-pine primary, earthy chart palette, Geist type everywhere (display: tight-tracked 600; data: Geist Mono; NO serifs), subtle dot-grid ground, sidebar aurora, staggered page-entry motion, sliding tab indicators. Use data-brand="mono" for the classic zinc/shadcn look. Voice orb: <span class="fx-orb" data-state="listening|speaking|muted">.

Motion set (add a class, done): fx-beam (AI-busy border light) · fx-shine-border (featured) · fx-spotlight (cursor highlight) · fx-fade-edges[-x] (scroll fades) · fx-anim-list (animated insertions) · [data-fx-stateful] buttons · fxVoiceBars(el).
AI set: fx-reasoning + fx-cot steps · fx-ctx context ring (--used %) · fx-island (data-mode idle|working|voice).
Domains (css/finix-domains.css + js/finix-domains.js): fx-tickertape · fxOrderBook · fx-ledger · fx-pricing/fx-plan/fx-usage · fx-entity + [data-fx-follow] · fxComments (@mentions, reactions) · fx-review-summary · fx-org (pure-CSS org chart) · fx-whosout · fxTimesheet (timer) · fx-matrix (self vs manager marks).
JS API: finix.setTheme(mode), finix.setBrand(brand), finix.toast({title, description, variant, action}), finix.openDialog(sel).
Activity timeline v2: fxActivity(el, {events}) — interleaved comment/status/system events, day-group headers, type filter chips, relative times; api.add(ev) animates new items in. Staged status: <ol class="fx-stages"> (+ --vertical) with li[data-state=done|active|pending|failed] — fulfillment, disputes, signing orders, approval chains.
Issues: fxIssues(el,{issues}) Linear-density grouped list w/ priority glyphs, status dots, j/k/x keyboard nav, hover actions. Swimlanes: .fx-kanban--lanes grid (lane heads sticky-left) composing .fx-kanban-card.
Workflow canvas (js/finix-canvas.js): fxCanvas(el,{nodes,edges,onSelect}) — pan/zoom node graph, drag-arrange, bezier edges w/ animated running dash, minimap, zoom bar, setStatus/setEdgeStatus for run animation; fxSchemaForm(el,schema,values,onChange) config forms. Run history: .fx-runs rows + fxJsonTree payloads.
Observability: fxTraceWaterfall(el,{spans}) nested span waterfall w/ collapse + tooltip; fxCharts.timeheat({rows,cols,values}) time heat grid; fxCharts.area threshold option + fxCharts.refresh(el) for live alert-rule lines.
Identity/audit (finix-devtools.js): fxPermMatrix(el,{roles,permissions,grants}) role x permission grid w/ inherited dots + cross-highlight; fxAuditLog(el,{entries}) actor/action/target trail with expandable before->after fxDiff.
Approvals: fxApprovals(el,{stages}) avatar chain w/ glow + approve/reject. Signature: fxSignature(el,{onApply}) draw/type -> PNG. Scheduling: fxSlotPicker(el,{availability,duration,onBook}) Calendly-style slots + timezone shift + availability editor API.
Accounting: fxRecon(el,{feed}) split-pane bank reconciliation (confidence-badged matches, running matched meter); fxAccountsTree(el,{tree,open}) chart-of-accounts hierarchy w/ rollup sums.
Commerce: fxSkuMatrix(el,{options:[{name,wrap}],prefix,defaults}) cartesian variant table from fx-tags inputs w/ inline price/stock edits; .fx-order-items/.fx-order-totals order detail composing fx-stages fulfillment.
Payments: .fx-payment (wallet row, [data-pay-number] brand detect, processing->success morph); fxCharts.candles({data:[{t,o,h,l,c}]}) candlestick w/ crosshair; .fx-doc printable A4 invoice frame (@media print isolation, window.print()).
Video call: fxCallTiles(el,{participants}) — speaking-ring rotation, mic/cam badges, screen-share hero layout, floating self tile, control bar.
Collaboration (js/finix-domains.js): fxMessages(el,{messages,channel,me}) Slack-style channel (day dividers, author grouping, unread line, hover actions, reaction chips); fxEmoji.open(anchor,cb) searchable picker; .fx-facepile presence avatars (data-presence, hover fan-out); fxToc(el,{target,scroller}) scroll-spy TOC.
Support (js/finix-domains.js): fxInbox(el,{tickets,macros,agent}) three-pane ticket inbox (queue chips + SLA countdowns, customer/agent/internal-note thread, macro popover, snooze/resolve, context rail). [data-fx-sla=epoch] live countdown chip (ok/warn/breach). [data-fx-csat] emoji CSAT widget.
Product tour: fxTour([{el,title,body}]).start() — SVG-mask spotlight coachmarks with animated cutout, dots, keyboard nav. NPS: <div data-fx-nps> auto-renders 0-10 banded scale -> follow-up -> thanks.
Feature flags: .fx-flags rows w/ per-env fx-switches; [data-fx-confirm-toggle="#dlg"] guards prod behind a confirm dialog; [data-fx-rollout] slider groups auto-balance to 100%; .fx-exp experiment rows with .fx-ci confidence-interval bars.
Devtools module (css/finix-devtools.css + js/finix-devtools.js): fxDiff(el, {before, after, file, mode}) — unified/split line diff (LCS), collapsed unchanged regions, add/del tints, mono gutters. fxJsonTree(el, data, {open}) collapsible type-colored JSON viewer. fx-apikeys rows (press-and-hold reveal via data-key, copy, rotate). [data-fx-envvars] masked KV editor. fxWebhookLog(el, {deliveries, onSelect}) delivery log -> fx-sheet payload drawer.
Master-detail: .fx-split[data-fx-split] split-pane (pointer-drag divider, collapse/expand, --flush for cards, --peek = right sheet on narrow) + fxPeek(el, {fields, onChange, onNav, onClose}) record panel with inline-editable fields and prev/next. fxDataGrid gained onRowClick, setActiveRow(i), getViewRows() for wiring.

Marketing kit (css/finix-marketing.css + js/finix-marketing.js, fx-mk-* namespace, standalone public pages — no admin shell): announcement bar; sticky blur navbar (.is-scrolled) + [data-mk-menu] mobile panel + [data-mk-theme] toggle; hero pieces (fx-mk-display + fx-mk-grad gradient span, fx-mk-pill badge, CTA row, social strip) over fx-mk-aurora/fx-mk-gridbg backdrops; fx-mk-browser frame hosting LIVE finix components (fade-bottom mask, blur teaser + preview tag); CSS logo marquee; fx-mk-bento 12-col grid with component media wells; fx-mk-zig rows; fx-mk-steps; [data-mk-count] counter-up stats; testimonial spotlight/carousel([data-mk-carousel])/tweet wall; integrations tiles; pricing tiers w/ annual-default [data-mk-bill] toggle (price bump) + fx-mk-compare table + [data-mk-roi] calculator; FAQ scaling; fx-mk-band CTA; footer w/ newsletter; [data-mk-waitlist] capture -> queue position + [data-mk-waitcount] increment + [data-mk-after-join] referral reveal; [data-mk-countdown=ISO] live timer; .fx-mk-reveal IO scroll-reveal (data-mk-delay stagger). Demo pages: demo/site/home.html (SaaS homepage), launch.html (waitlist), pricing.html.

## Conventions

- Components are semantic classes prefixed fx- (fx-btn, fx-card, fx-menu-item). Variants use -- modifiers (fx-btn--outline). No utility classes required.
- Behaviors attach via data attributes and native attributes:
  - dialogs: <button data-fx-open="#id"> … <dialog class="fx-dialog" id="id"> … <button data-fx-close>
  - menus/popovers: <button popovertarget="id"> + <div class="fx-menu" popover id="id"> (auto-positioned)
  - tooltips: data-fx-tip="text"
  - table sort: <button class="fx-th-sort"> inside <th>; filter: <input data-fx-table-filter="#tableId">
  - calendar: <div class="fx-cal" data-fx-calendar data-fx-cal-input="#input">
  - number ticker: <div data-fx-ticker="$45,231.89">
- Error state on inputs: aria-invalid="true".
- All colors come from CSS custom properties (--primary, --background, --chart-1…5). Never hardcode colors; use var(--token).
- SURFACE LADDER (depth = lightness, Google-style): --background (canvas) < --well (inset panels ON surfaces: toolbars, column wells, code blocks, grid headers) < --card (surfaces) < --popover (overlays; lighter than cards in dark mode). Hover fills always use --hover; internal dividers use --border-soft; structural container borders use --border. When building new components, pick the rung — never invent a new gray mix.

## Tier 1 additions (v0.2)

- Data grid: include css/finix-datagrid.css + js/finix-datagrid.js, then fxDataGrid(el, {columns, data, select, pageSize, pinned, maxHeight}). Sort, search, column resize/reorder/pin/hide, dblclick inline edit, selection, pagination. Pair with fxFilterBar(el, {fields, onChange}) → grid.setPredicate for Linear-style filter chips.
- Date-range picker: <div data-fx-calendar-range data-fx-cal-input="#label"> — dual months + presets, fires fx:range.
- Phone input: wrap input in .fx-input-group[data-fx-phone] (dial-code dropdown auto-injected). Mask: input[data-fx-mask="99/99"]. Number field: .fx-numberfield with [data-step] buttons. Password: [data-fx-password-toggle="#input"] + input[data-fx-strength="#meter"].
- Multi-select: .fx-combobox[data-fx-multi] with checkbox fx-menu-items → chips in trigger.
- Dropzone: .fx-dropzone with hidden file input; previews + progress auto-rendered into .fx-dropfiles.
- Sortable list: .fx-sortable > .fx-sortable-item (drag-reorder).
- Notification center: bell button.fx-bell-dot + .fx-notif-panel popover; [data-fx-notif-readall].
- Stacked dialogs: [data-fx-open-stacked="#child"] inside a parent dialog. Confirm-typing: input[data-fx-confirm="name"] + [data-fx-confirm-btn].
- Auth template: demo/auth.html (sign-in / sign-up / forgot / 2FA).

## Tier 2/3 additions (v0.3)

- Apps module (css/finix-apps.css + js/finix-apps.js): fxEventCalendar (month/week, drag events), fxGantt (draggable timeline bars), fxFilterBuilder (Notion-style AND/OR typed rules), fxLogTable (virtualized 50k rows, live tail), fxImporter (4-step CSV import wizard: upload/drop -> auto-matched mapping -> validate w/ inline fixes -> import).
- Editor module (js/finix-editor.js): fxEditor (toolbar + bubble menu + '/' slash commands + markdown shortcuts, .getHTML()), fxCropper (crop box with aspect lock and canvas output).
- Chart additions in demo/charts.js: hbars, combo (bars+line dual axis), scatter, gauge; line mode (fill:false), negative bars, click-to-toggle legends; funnel (stepped bars + drop-off slopes) and cohort (triangular retention matrix, sequential ramp).
- Command palette v2: fuzzy matching + Recent group (localStorage).
- AI assistant page (demo/ai.html): fx-ai layout, fx-toolcall collapsible blocks, fx-approval cards, fx-branch picker, fx-prose markdown styles.

## Industry & mobile modules (v0.4)

All optional, all namespaced; include the module's css+js and go.

- CRM (css/finix-crm.css + js/finix-crm.js, fx-crm-*): fxPipeline(el,{stages,deals,winRate,onMove}) weighted pipeline board w/ pointer-drag + live rollups; fxScore(el,{score,factors,popover}) lead-score ring; fxQuote(el,{products,lines,taxRate,approvalThreshold,onApproval}) CPQ w/ live math + approval gate; contact-360 recipe on fx-split (demo/crm.html).
- Trading (css/finix-trading.css + js/finix-trading.js, fx-tr-*): fxWatchlist (live ticks + sparks), fxOrderTicket (margin math, MIS/CNC, SL types), fxOptionChain (ITM shading, ATM row, OI bars, setSpot), fxDepth (5-level book), fxPositions (positions/holdings P&L, Exit), fxBlotter (filling order log). Terminal layout: demo/trading.html.
- Flows (css/finix-flows.css + js/finix-flows.js, fx-wiz-*): fxWizard(el,{storageKey,focus,next,validate,onFinish}) — declarative [data-step] sections, rail, branching, native+custom validation, auto review step (data-label/data-secret), localStorage resume, focus/survey mode w/ keyboard advance. Checkout/KYC/survey demos: demo/flows.html.
- Mobile (css/finix-mobile.css + js/finix-mobile.js, fx-m-*): .fx-phone device frame w/ container-query screens; fxSheet snap bottom sheet; auto-wired swipe rows, tab bar, FAB speed dial ([data-m-fab]), large-title collapse, pull-to-refresh ([data-m-refresh] → "fx-refresh" event); grouped lists, segmented, chat bubbles, numpad. Six composed screens: demo/mobile.html.
- Shop (css/finix-shop.css + js/finix-shop.js, fx-shop-*, public web): FX_PRODUCTS catalog, fxShopCard renderer (CSS gradient art — no images), fxShopGrid live PLP filters (chips/histogram/swatches/rating/sort), fxShopCart localStorage cart + drawer w/ free-shipping meter, PDP recipe w/ variants. Pages: demo/site/store.html + product.html?id=.
- Banking (css/finix-bank.css + js/finix-bank.js, fx-bank-*): fxBankFeed (day groups, running balance, category chips, api.add), fxBankCard (freeze + hold-to-reveal CVV), fxTransfer (recipients + keypad + review + onSend), fxBankBudgets rings; balance hero, bill rows, CSS UPI QR. Page: demo/banking.html.
- Ops (fx-ops-* in css/finix-devtools.css): incident queue rows + SEV chips, on-call rotation strip w/ now marker, escalation on fx-stages; public status page recipe (fx-ops-banner + fx-tracker uptime bars + computed %). Pages: demo/ops.html + demo/site/status.html.

## Files

- manifest.json: machine-readable registry — every component with its classes, markup snippet, and JS hook.
- css/tokens.css: OKLCH tokens; light/dark modes x 4 brand presets. Add a brand by overriding --primary/--ring/--chart-* under [data-brand="yourbrand"].
- css/finix.css: primitives (buttons, forms, tables, tabs, menus, dialogs, toasts, steppers, trees, calendars…).
- css/finix-widgets.css: composites (app shell/sidebar/topbar, stat cards, tracker, bar list, kanban, chat, chart chrome).
- js/finix.js: all behaviors, delegated; safe on dynamic DOM for click-driven features.
- demo/: full admin template, 24 pages — dashboard, forms, data, overlays, feedback, charts, projects, flows, ai, mobile, crm, trading, banking, support, business, devtools, workflow, people, collab, ops, editor, motion, auth, research — plus a 6-page public site (demo/site/: home, launch, pricing, store, product, status).
- demo/charts.js: optional dependency-free SVG charts — fxCharts.area/bars/donut/spark(el, opts); re-render on theme change.

## Provenance

Visual language: shadcn/ui v4 (MIT). Patterns adopted from free tiers of: ReUI (data tables, tree, kanban, timeline), Kibo UI (kanban, heatmap, choicebox, tags), Tremor (tracker, bar list, category bar, progress circle), shadcn Charts (chart look), assistant-ui (chat anatomy), Shadcn Studio (input groups, stepper, rating), Animate UI / Motion Primitives (animation specs), Kokonut (AI composer), Cult UI (popover form), tablecn/DiceUI (table UX). All MIT/Apache-2.0. See demo/research.html.
